description: Defines simple data models for a dummy STB app, including VodItem, Channel, and EpgProgram data classes.

classes.name: VodItem
classes.description: Represents a video-on-demand item with properties like id, title, description, duration, category, and thumbnail resource name.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: Represents a TV channel with properties id and name.

classes.name: EpgProgram
classes.description: Represents an electronic program guide entry with properties like id, channelId, title, description, start and end times in epoch milliseconds.
